description:
Create a scatterplot to visualize the relationship between Revision time and Exam performance. 

1. Open the file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv' (it contains columns: Code, Revise, Exam, Anxiety, Gender).
2. Create a Scatterplot (under 'Exploration' or 'Analyses > Exploration > Scatterplot').
3. Set 'Revise' as the X-Axis and 'Exam' as the Y-Axis.
4. Group the data by 'Gender'.
5. Add a 'Linear' regression line with 'Standard Error' shading enabled.
6. Add 'Density' plots to the margins (Marginals).
7. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamScatterplot.omv'.
